title: Sharp singularity rates for symmetric random sign matrices

result.label: Sharp singularity rates for symmetric random sign matrices
result.statement: Determines the sharp exponential singularity rate of symmetric random sign matrices with independent entries on and above the diagonal. Uniform signs give ( An=0)=(1/2+o(1))^n; for fixed bias p (0,1) 1/2 , the rate is (p^2+(1-p)^2+o(1))^n. In the biased case, agreeing rows attain this rate.
